critical_issues: frontend/next.config.ts: API proxy destination hardcoded to production URL `https://agent-job-production.up.railway.app` — breaks local dev and exposes internal infrastructure in committed code. This should be an environment variable.

API router refactor (activities, automation, customers, notifications, rbac, reports, sales, tenants, tickets, users): All routers replaced `async with get_db() as session:` context manager pattern with `session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)`. This is an architectural change — need to verify `get_db` is actually a FastAPI dependency (not a context manager) in `db/connection.py`, otherwise runtime errors will occur.

No global AppException handler added to `main.py` — the router refactor depends on a global exception handler converting AppException subclasses to JSON responses, but this handler is not shown in the diff. Without it, all services raising exceptions will produce unhandled 500 errors.
suggestions: Use environment variable for the frontend API proxy destination instead of hardcoding production URL
Add `app.add_exception_handler(AppException, ...)` to main.py if not already present
The deleted workflow files (pipeline-qc.yml, pipeline-test.yml) leave no CI coverage for QC or Test stages — verify these are handled elsewhere
pipeline-code-review.yml now triggers on all PRs and pushes (`branches: ['*']`) — consider scoping to specific branches to avoid unnecessary pipeline runs
The `auto_assign` method in ticket_service returns `dict` but other methods return `Ticket` ORM object — inconsistent return types within the same service
summary: Commit introduces significant architectural changes (ApiResponse → exception pattern, session injection refactor, ruff migration) with a critical hardcoded production URL in the frontend config that must be fixed before merging.
